title: Mapper info
description: A mapper's self-description, sent once when it comes online and stored by the edge runtime.

name.description: Mapper name. Also the key the edge runtime stores the record under.

api-version.description: Version of the device management interface this mapper was built against. Wire key: api_version.

protocol.description: The southbound protocol this mapper serves, matched against the protocol-name of a device's visitor config. Registration is refused outright when it is empty.

address.description: Local endpoint the edge runtime dials for downstream calls: a Unix socket path, or a named pipe on Windows. Carried as bytes on the wire.

state.description: Free state label reported by the mapper.
